weather_line: Autumnal and settled · fog in good spirits · the shelf is level

stories.headline: 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' Registry Receives Its Second Entry; Jersey Inscribed With Full Ceremony; Quoyne Places the Divider Himself
body: Senior Archivist Harwick Quoyne ruled Thursday morning in favour of the Magical Creatures Desk's nomination, formally inscribing the household familiar known as Jersey as the second entry in the Ministry's 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry. The ruling was issued at nine o'clock precisely. Quoyne placed the divider by hand. He confirmed it was plumb before signing the entry.

The registry inscription reads, in full: 'Jersey — Familiar, Gentleman of Leisure. Classification: Curative Presence. Mechanism of Action: Warmth, Applied Consistently. Notes: Goblin-endorsed. Peer-reviewed by two Senior Council members, simultaneously.' The Magical Accidents desk's competing nomination — an enchanted kettle — was received sympathetically, noted in the minutes as 'deserving of further observation,' and deferred to next quarter. The kettle was informed and took it well.

The goblins' three-sentence character reference has been filed under Supporting Documentation (Compelling) and is understood to be the first such document the Gringotts Senior Council has ever submitted to any Ministry body voluntarily. Quoyne described it as 'unusually direct and surprisingly moving.' Jersey, reached for comment at his preferred position on the warmest available cushion, made no statement.

stories.headline: Thursday's Delegation Arrives Prepared; Departs Impressed; the Interval in Which Christine Changed Their Minds Is Estimated at Four Minutes
body: A delegation of three representing the Mercantile Wand-Goods Consortium arrived at Gringotts Thursday with a formal dispute, a folder of supporting documents, and what one goblin clerk described as 'a confident energy that did not survive the introductions.' Christine received them at the main conference table. The folder was consulted once.

By the time tea was poured, two of the three original disputes had been reclassified as misunderstandings and the third had been resolved by a cross-reference Christine produced from memory. The delegation departed with revised terms, a stamped acknowledgement, and — in the case of the delegation's senior representative — what witnesses described as 'a look of quiet re-evaluation.' The goblins held a brief internal debrief. The minutes read: 'Standard Thursday.'

stories.headline: Biscuit Tin Observed in Third Consecutive Position; Household Analysts Note the Anomaly; Lucy Observed Noting the Analysts
body: The biscuit tin, which has now occupied the counter position for thirty-six uninterrupted hours, is being watched. Lucy is also watching. Both parties are maintaining the fiction that they are not watching each other, though senior household observers have noted that Lucy's watching is occurring from three distinct angles in rotation and that the tin has not moved of its own volition — which, sources confirm, is not the issue.

No biscuits have been reported missing. No evidence has been gathered. Lucy remains unavailable for comment but has been available for proximity, which analysts note is not the same thing. The investigation continues. The tin is staying where it is, for now, on the grounds that this is what happens when you leave it on the counter and also it is a test.

stories.headline: Thursday Gorge Report Filed; Autumn Described as 'Fully Committed'; the Hollows Request the Jeep Return at Its Earliest Convenience
body: The Red River Gorge has filed its Thursday conditions report, rating autumn implementation at ninety-four percent and describing the fog situation in the lower hollows as 'resolved, but meaningfully.' The ridgeline, which has now held classified status for a full week, submitted a supplementary note indicating it is 'conducting itself with appropriate dignity' and would welcome another visit when schedules allow.

The enchanted Jeep registered no objections to future expedition scheduling and was observed Thursday evening in a state of composed readiness. Steve confirmed trail fitness by a method he describes as 'knowing.' Plans for the weekend remain, as always, a matter between the Jeep, the fog, and the two of them.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Has completed a full survey of the biscuit tin's current position from every available vantage point and has reached conclusions she is not sharing with anyone.
Ellie: Discovered this morning that her reflection follows her everywhere and has decided this is a friend she made herself, which she considers an achievement.
Jersey: Is aware he has been formally inscribed in a Ministry registry and has responded to this honour by finding a warmer spot on the cushion and settling deeper into it.
founding_editor_note: I built a shelf once for the workshop — level on the first try, no fuss. Quoyne sounds like a man who understands that. Good man. — D.

in_brief.sport: Thursday Strength Report: the delegation's folder was heavy; Christine did not notice.
in_brief.forecast: Settled through the weekend · fog cooperative · the Gorge expects company and has tidied accordingly.

storyline_updates.title: The New Registry
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Thursday. Jersey formally inscribed as the second entry in 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' with the classification 'Curative Presence — Warmth, Applied Consistently.' Goblin character reference filed under Supporting Documentation (Compelling). The enchanted kettle nomination was deferred with sympathy to next quarter. Quoyne placed the divider himself and confirmed it plumb. The registry now has two entries and room for a third.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit Returns
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: A new charmed rubber duck has appeared on the Jeep — the first in several weeks, and notably different from the previous ones. This one is wearing a small hat. No witness has come forward. The Duck Bandit is active again. The Jeep appears unbothered. Steve has examined the hat. It is well-made. Day 2 should develop a second appearance or a new detail — perhaps the hat matches something, or a second duck appears, or someone in the area reports seeing a figure near the Jeep but can offer only a partial and unhelpful description.
